services.desc: From baitcasting powerhouses like the Hamarr and Cyclone to versatile spinning models including the Banshee, Dreadnought, Karve, and Drekar series, Sixgill Fishing delivers precision-engineered reels for every fishing style. Available in multiple sizes and gear ratios, our reels combine smooth performance, durability, and advanced technology to help you land more fish in any condition. blurb: Sixgill Fishing Products offers a range of fishing gear including high-performance reels, quality rods for various fishing styles, and reel accessories. Their products cater to anglers of all skill levels, from beginners to pros. The company is based in North Texas and focuses on delivering quality and value.
